closeout_operational_negatives.summary: The first post-evidence inspection wrapper had an unterminated PowerShell string and returned no file inspection output.
A broad inherited-generator patch failed exact-context verification on mixed-encoding text and applied no changes.
A combined main-contract patch was rejected atomically when one inherited mojibake line failed exact-context verification.
The first closeout build preflight rejected an expected Method Flow validation file that was absent from its exact allow-list.
The first closeout wrapper continued into tests after the native builder failed, producing nine missing-artifact errors with zero test credit.
The second closeout preflight used a numeric m2 prefix that covered records 26 through 29 but rejected the valid record 30.
The post-Index deterministic closeout rebuild rejected its own already-generated final output directories because the preflight recognized only first-run paths.
